common.saved: Saved · the link in your confirmation email brings you back here

start.title: Your financing request in a few minutes.
start.lead: Answer a few questions. We tell you right away which documents are needed – and then read them for you.
start.advisor.title: HYPOTEQ advisor
start.advisor.sub: I am submitting the request on behalf of a client.
start.client.title: Client
start.client.sub: I am submitting my own financing request.
start.claim: Thanks to HYPOTEQ, mortgages have become comparable. Your advisor, however, is unique.®

s1.title: New financing request
s1.lead: A few details on the request – on the right you see right away which documents follow from them.
s1.advisorEmailHint: That’s all we need – we recognise you by your address.
s1.noPartner.title: Not a partner yet?
s1.noPartner.text: We don’t know this address yet. Register in one minute – then the request continues as usual.
s1.noPartner.note: HYPOTEQ checks your details and will get in touch if there are questions. You can already enter the request now.
s1.contactNote: That’s all for now – we read date of birth, address and marital status from your documents.

q.nbDocs: Are the land register extract and building insurance policy already available?
q.nbDocs.hint: Often not yet for new builds – we will ask for them later.
q.heizung.hint: For possible green conditions from the banks. “Unknown” is fine – we check it in the documents.
q.baurecht: Is the property held under a building right?
q.reno: Are there renovations or costs on top of the purchase price?
q.job.hint: Self-employed people submit annual accounts instead of salary certificates.
q.ab50.hint: If yes: AHV pension forecast and pillar 3 values.
q.kredite.hint: Personal loans are reported to the ZEK credit bureau. Stating them early avoids queries from the bank.
q.buerge: Is a joint and several guarantee needed?
q.s3a.hint: If yes: certificate and policy incl. value statement.

s2.title: What are we financing?
s2.lead: Each answer determines which documents we need later. Nothing has to be entered twice.
s2.fromDocs: We read the address, year of construction and land register data from the documents later.
s2.existingMortgageHint: We read the bank, product and maturity date from the interest statement.
s2.purposePh: What will the increase be used for?

s3.title: Who is financing?
s3.lead: We need the same documents per borrower. Additional questions only add to the list if they apply.
s3.incomeHint: We read date of birth, address and employer from the ID and salary certificate.
s3.companyName: Company name as per commercial register
s3.jpNote: We read the UID, registered office and signing authority from the commercial register extract.

s4.title: Financing
s4.valueHint: Estimate, last purchase price or market value
s4.affHint: Imputed 5 % interest, amortisation, 1 % running costs · max. 33 %
s4.equityVia: Does part of the equity come from …
s4.commentsPh: Anything else the bank should know
s4.lead: You see the loan-to-value and affordability right away. Equity questions stay on No until you change them.

s5.title: Upload documents
s5.lead: All at once, in any order. HYPOTEQ recognises each document, assigns it and reads the relevant details.
s5.dropSub: PDF, JPG, PNG. Whole folders are fine. You don’t need to say which document is which.

doc.fotos: Photos of the property (interior and exterior)
doc.stwe_plan: Building / floor plans incl. net living area
doc.grundbuch: Current land register extract (max. 6 months old)
doc.gvz: Current building insurance policy (incl. cubic volume)
doc.projekt: Project plans, construction description and contract incl. cost summary and cubic volume
doc.stwe_regl: Deed of establishment with value quotas · use and management regulations
doc.mieterspiegel: Current tenancy schedule incl. rental income
doc.lohnausweise: Salary certificates for the last 3 years
doc.abschluss_se: Balance sheet and income statement (incl. audit report) for the last 3 years
doc.wb: Passport / ID of the authorised signatory
doc.jahresabschluss: Annual accounts (balance sheet and income statement) for the last 3 years
doc.pkvorbezug: Confirmation of pension fund withdrawal / pledge

sug.loan.title: We recognised a loan or lease agreement.
sug.loan.text: Your answer for “personal loans” or “leases” is No. Should it be set to Yes?
sug.maint.title: We recognised a maintenance agreement.
sug.maint.text: Your answers on children and maintenance payments are No. Should both be set to Yes?
sug.3a.title: We recognised pillar 3a documents.
sug.3a.text: Your answer for “pillar 3a” is No. Should it be set to Yes?
sug.stwe.title: We recognised condominium documents.
sug.stwe.text: The property is not recorded as a condominium. Should the type be changed?

docs.progressBusy: You can carry on – the list updates itself.
docs.uploadLost: The page was reloaded before the file had uploaded. Please choose it again.
docs.x.full: This requirement is already complete – kept in the case file, not counted.
docs.x.period: Not from the requested years ({years}) – kept in the case file, not counted.
docs.x.duplicate: Same content as {name} – not stored twice.
docs.x.notneeded: Not required for the financing review.
docs.x.offList: Does not match any requirement of your answers – kept in the case file.
docs.x.offListSug: Does not match any requirement of your answers – see the note above.
docs.x.dismissed: Not used – does not match any requirement of your answers.
docs.x.unknown: We could not tell what kind of document this is. Please assign it.
docs.x.failed: The file could not be read. Please assign it.
docs.x.person: We could not tell whose document this is. Please assign it.
docs.old.maxAge: Older than {months} months (document date {date}). The bank needs a current document.
docs.old.year: Not current (year {year}). The bank needs the current document.
docs.old.expired: Expired on {date}. Please upload a valid document.
docs.old.generic: This document is no longer current. The bank needs a current one.
docs.overridden: Used anyway – the bank will be told.
docs.noFields: No details were read from this document.
docs.caseLater: The case number («HQ-…») is assigned when you complete the request.
docs.toast.extra: {n} file(s) not needed or surplus – kept, not counted
docs.toast.type: {name}: PDF, JPG, PNG, HEIC or WebP only
docs.internMeta: Thresholds 90 / 70 % · percentages and audit trail are internal only
docs.audit.aiOff: Automatic recognition is switched off on this environment

s6.titleOk: We can finance this. On to the bank.
s6.title: Final look at the request
s6.leadMissing: Almost done – {n} document(s) still missing. The case can still be submitted; missing documents will follow.
s6.leadOk: All details and documents are complete.
s6.fromDocsLine: {n} details extracted instead of asked · {m} confirmed manually
s6.submitText: On submission, the case goes to HYPOTEQ for the bank request. The case dossier summarises all details and documents for the lender.
s6.doneSub: {name} will receive a confirmation at {email}. The dossier is ready for the bank request.

rail.title: Your documents
rail.text: documents are needed for this request. The list only grows with your answers.

val.email: Please enter a valid email address.
val.amount: Please enter an amount in CHF.
